change_summary: Repaired stale play completion and current media pause handling in the regular player. A completed old play promise no longer pauses a newer attempt. A genuine media pause cancels play intent, releases the shared lock, and updates the control; a queued old pause is ignored when the element is currently playing. Versioned fixed and country resources to radio-v5 and country-v3 and updated README references.
decisions: Preserved the existing Web Lock and BroadcastChannel ownership protocol and did not change CSP, endpoints, identity, or visual design.
Used the media element's current paused state to distinguish a queued old pause event from a current stop after a newer playback attempt starts.
